name: Talarrubias (Spain)
description: Three horizontal stripes of green, white and blue in the proportions 4:1:1, the green charged with the crowned municipal arms of Talarrubias (waves, a chequy field and a tree).
history: Municipal flag of Talarrubias; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Talarrubias arms — waves, chequy and tree
